news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹45.33 (up from ₹25.85 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹31.4b (up 9.0% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹6.20b (up 76% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 20% (up from 12% in FY 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 2.8%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 22%. Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 12% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 9% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 31% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Eris Lifesciences Limited (NSEI:ERIS) agreed to acquire remaining 30% stake in Swiss Parenterals Limited from Naishadh Shah for INR 3.8 billion.
news.body:
Eris Lifesciences Limited (NSEI:ERIS) agreed to acquire remaining 30% stake in Swiss Parenterals Limited from Naishadh Shah for INR 3.8 billion on November 24, 2025. The acquisition of 30% stake in Swiss by Eris Lifesciences from Naishadh Shah is proposed to be undertaken for a total purchase consideration of INR 423,30,00,000, which will be discharged by the Company by way of issuance of up to 23,06,372 equity shares, representing a 1.69% stake of Eris Lifesciences on a preferential basis to Naishadh Shah. Upon completion, Eris Lifesciences Limited will own 100% stake in Swiss Parenterals Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Swiss Parenterals Limited reported total revenue of INR 35.11 million.
